(def ^:private str_
"Implementation detail. Internal str without circularity on IndexedSeq.
  @param x
  @param {...*} var_args"
  (let [seq seq first first next next number? number? string? string? identical? identical? nil? nil?]
    (fn
      ([] "")
      ([x] (if (nil? x) ""
             (if (or (string? x) (number? x) (or (identical? x true) (identical? x false)))
               (suss.bootstrap/coerce-string x)
               (.toString x))))
      ([x & more]
       (if (nil? x) ""
         (loop [result (str_ x) remaining (seq more)]
           (if remaining
             (recur (suss.bootstrap/concat-string result (str_ (first remaining)))
                    (next remaining))
             result)))))))
